crossRefs.note: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”
translations.bsb: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, “Depart from us, for you are much too powerful for us.”
translations.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier
translations.asv: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us. For thou art much mightier than we.
